beauty.title: Cosmetics / Jewellery
beauty.menuTip: Write the shade or size in the name, and link a barcode with "barcode <product> <code>" for the scanner.
tips: Write the shade / size / colour in the product name ("Lipstick Matte Red"): each shade keeps its own stock.
If you have a barcode scanner, link the code with "barcode Lipstick Matte Red 8964000123".
For a gift wrap or a similar note, write "note 12 gift wrap": it is printed on the receipt.

clothing.title: Clothing / Lawn / Boutique
clothing.menuTip: Write the size and colour with the product name, then check stock with "stock".
clothing.dataFocus: cost price, category (lawn / stitched / bridal) and stock
tips: Write the design number in the product name, e.g. "Design 1203 - 3500": say that same name in the order.
For size and colour write: "Kurti - 1800, size M, color blue".
Before Eid or the lawn season, ask: "which product is about to run out".

electronics.title: Electronics / Mobile
electronics.menuTip: Write the model and wattage in the name, and scan a barcode at the counter for every item.
tips: Write the model / wattage / variant in the name so the wrong item is not sold.
Link a barcode to every item ("barcode Earbuds Pro 8964000999"), then sell by scanning at the counter.
For warranty or serial numbers, write "note 12 serial 12345 warranty 1 year".

food.title: Food / Bakery
food.menuTip: Write the advance as "order 12 advance 1000" and add the delivery charge in the order.
food.dataFocus: advance payment, delivery charge and cost price
tips: For orders taken in advance, write the advance: "order 12 advance 1000", or "…, advance 1000" in the order.
Write the delivery charge in the order ("…, delivery 300"), or set the default with "delivery 300".
For a customer's special request ("photo cake, name Ali"), write "note 12 <text>".

general.title: General shop
general.menuTip: Write the cost with every product: profit and margin come out right. Type "industry" to choose your kind of shop.
tips: Write the cost with every product, e.g. "Water Bottle - 500, cost 350": this keeps profit right.
When an order arrives, be sure to write "mark 3 shipped" / "mark 3 delivered".
To choose your kind of shop, type "industry": the examples will then match your shop.

grocery.title: Grocery / Kiryana
grocery.menuTip: Write the pack weight in the name, and keep stock: the bot warns you when it runs low.
grocery.dataFocus: stock, pack size and cost price
tips: Write the weight or pack with the name: "Sugar 5 kg - 500": a 5 kg pack is one product.
Always write the stock ("stock Sugar 5 kg 40"): the bot tells you when it is low.
When stock is 3 or less, the bot sends a warning on its own.

hardware.title: Hardware / Building
hardware.menuTip: Write the size and unit in the name, and see the credit balance with "unpaid orders".
tips: Write the size / unit in the name ("PVC Pipe 1 inch"): one item in different sizes is a different product.
For credit or money owed, write "order 12 advance 5000": the remaining balance shows in "unpaid orders".
To see goods by supplier, write "supplier Wall Paint Ali Traders".
